title: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN RADEC BERBASIS LIVEWORKSHEETS TERHADAP LITERASI DIGITAL DAN HASIL BELAJAR KOGNITIF SISWA KELAS X MAN 2 KOTA TASIKMALAYA PADA MATERI EKOSISTEM
text_snippet: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN RADEC BERBASIS LIVEWORKSHEETS TERHADAP LITERASI DIGITAL DAN HASIL BELAJAR KOGNITIF SISWA KELAS X MAN 2 KOTA TASIKMALAYA PADA MATERI EKOSISTEM Biology learning that relies predominantly on less varied and interactive instructional models may result in limited student participation, low digital literacy, and suboptimal learning outcomes. This study aims to investigate the effect of the Liveworksheets-assisted RADEC learning model on students’ digital literacy skills and cognitive learning outcomes in ecosystem material. A quasi-experimental method was employed using a posttest-only control group design. The population comprised 286 tenth-grade students at MAN 2 Kota Tasikmalaya. The sample was selected through purposive sampling and consisted of 35 students in the experimental class (X-1) and 36 students in the control class (X-5). The experimental class was taught using the RADEC learning model integrated with Liveworksheets, whereas the control class received discovery learning. Data were collected using a 21-item digital literacy questionnaire and a 42-item validated cognitive learning test. The data were analyzed using an independent-samples t-test with the assistance of SPSS. The findings revealed a significant difference between the experimental and control classes. title: IDENTIFIKASI GUGUS FUNGSI PADA MINYAK ATSIRI DAUN SINGKIL (Premna corymbosa) MENGGUNAKAN SPEKTROSKOPI FOURIER TRANSFORM INFRARED (FTIR)
text_snippet: IDENTIFIKASI GUGUS FUNGSI PADA MINYAK ATSIRI DAUN SINGKIL (Premna corymbosa) MENGGUNAKAN SPEKTROSKOPI FOURIER TRANSFORM INFRARED (FTIR) Essential oils are complex mixtures of volatile secondary metabolites with significant biological activities, including antibacterial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. Singkil leaves (Premna corymbosa) represent a potential natural source of essential oils containing various bioactive compounds. This study aimed to identify the functional groups present in the essential oil extracted from singkil leaves using Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. The essential oil sample was analyzed using a Bruker OPUS 8.9.7 FTIR spectrometer within a wavenumber range of 400–4000 cm⁻¹. The FTIR spectrum exhibited four characteristic absorption bands: O–H stretching at 3287.79 cm⁻¹, an overtone/combination band at 2100.64 cm⁻¹, aromatic C=C stretching at 1635.78 cm⁻¹, and fingerprint region peaks at 461.99–413.34 cm⁻¹. These features indicate the presence of phenolics, flavonoids, furanoid sesquiterpenes, and amide alkaloids in the essential oil. Spectral library matching provided candidate structures with high similarity; however, these identifications remain putative and require confirmation with complementary analytical techniques. title: PENGEMBANGAN E-MODUL BERBASIS PBL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KRITIS SISWA SMA KELAS XI PADA MATERI SISTEM EKSKRESI
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN E-MODUL BERBASIS PBL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KRITIS SISWA SMA KELAS XI PADA MATERI SISTEM EKSKRESI Pendidikan abad 21 menuntut peserta didik untuk memiliki kemampuan berpikir kritis, dan mampu memecahkan masalah dalam berbagai konteks kehidupan. Untuk mencapai tujuan tersebut, diperlukan media pembelajaran yang inovatif dan kontekstual seperti e-modul. title: Pengembangan Model Pembelajaran DZHAI sebagai Inovasi Problem Based Learning untuk Mendorong Deep Learning dalam Pembelajaran Biologi
text_snippet: Pengembangan Model Pembelajaran DZHAI sebagai Inovasi Problem Based Learning untuk Mendorong Deep Learning dalam Pembelajaran Biologi Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan model pembelajaran DZHAI (Define, Zoom, Highlight, Apply, Integrate) sebagai penyempurnaan dari Problem Based Learning (PBL) dalam konteks pembelajaran biologi. Kajian ini dilakukan melalui metode kualitatif kepustakaan (library research) dengan menelaah berbagai sumber ilmiah seperti buku, jurnal, dan artikel penelitian relevan. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa meskipun PBL efektif dalam mengembangkan keterampilan berpikir kritis, kolaboratif, dan pemecahan masalah, implementasinya masih menghadapi sejumlah kendala. Di antaranya adalah ketidaksiapan siswa dalam belajar mandiri, masalah yang terlalu kompleks, keterbatasan refleksi, serta penilaian yang belum berkelanjutan. Model DZHAI dirancang untuk menutup celah tersebut melalui lima tahapan yang saling melengkapi dan bersifat modular. Tahap Define membantu membangun pemahaman dasar; Zoom memperdalam fokus konsep; Highlight menekankan kolaborasi dan klarifikasi ide; Apply mendorong penerapan konsep dalam konteks nyata; dan Integrate memperkuat refleksi serta koneksi antar konsep. title: Pengembangan Modul Ajar Berbasis PjBL pada Subkonsep Fotosintesis terhadap Kemampuan Berpikir Kreatif Siswa Kelas XII
text_snippet: Pengembangan Modul Ajar Berbasis PjBL pada Subkonsep Fotosintesis terhadap Kemampuan Berpikir Kreatif Siswa Kelas XII Competition in the 21st century globalization era is very tight in various fields including education, therefore students are required to be creative individuals in order to compete. One effective method to train students' creative thinking skills is by designing teaching modules to facilitate the creative learning process. This study aims to describe the validity, practicality, and effectiveness of the results of the development of PjBL-based teaching modules on photosynthesis sub-concepts on the creative thinking skills of class XII students. This development research uses the 4D model (Thiagarajan et al., 1974) which is carried out until the disseminate stage in the test school. Data collection techniques used validity, practicality, and effectiveness instruments. The subjects of this study consisted of 2 experts for media and material validation, 9 students for practicality testing and 1 class consisting of 23 students for effectiveness testing and implementation. title: Pengembangan Media Pembelajaran Biomovly Board Game untuk Meningkatkan Keterampilan Kolaborasi dan Hasil Belajar Kognitif Siswa Kelas XI SMA
text_snippet: Pengembangan Media Pembelajaran Biomovly Board Game untuk Meningkatkan Keterampilan Kolaborasi dan Hasil Belajar Kognitif Siswa Kelas XI SMA Collaborative skills and cognitive learning outcomes in biology, especially in Musculoskeletal System material, remain suboptimal and need improvement. The purpose of this study to develop a Biomovly Board Game learning media that valid, practical, and effective to improving collaboration skills and learning outcomes of grade XI Phase F students in the Musculoskeletal System material. The development of the Biomovly Board Game follows the ADDIE model, which consists of the following stages: Analyze, Design, Develop, Implement, and Evaluate. The research involved students at SMA Negeri 2 Batu, East Java from July to December 2025, using a pre-experimental research design. The results showed that the media had been tested for validity by subject matter experts (100%) with a category of highly valid, media experts (100%) with a category of highly valid, and biology education practitioners (93.1%) with a category of valid. The practicality of the media was tested, yielding a 86.71% practicality rating. title: EKSPLORASI ETNOBOTANI DALAM UPACARA PERNIKAHAN ADAT LAMPUNG PEPADUN SEBAGAI SUMBER BELAJAR BIOLOGI DI SMA
text_snippet: EKSPLORASI ETNOBOTANI DALAM UPACARA PERNIKAHAN ADAT LAMPUNG PEPADUN SEBAGAI SUMBER BELAJAR BIOLOGI DI SMA This study aims to identify the sequence of wedding ceremony rituals, the types of plants used, and how these plants are utilized. It was a qualitative field study that employed data collection techniques such as interviews, observations, and documentation. The data analysis followed the framework established by Miles et al. (2014), which includes data reduction, data display, and drawing conclusions. The participants in this study consisted of five individuals. The results indicated that there were ten traditional rituals involved in the wedding ceremonies: ngakuk mulei/sebumangan, nyuakbidang sukew, ngattak salah, nyuak sabai, ngulem/nyuak, sujud/ngayew meghiyan, nickel, nginai adek, pangan/pesta, and ngemighul. In the Lampung traditional wedding rituals, twenty-five types of plants are utilized. The specific parts of these plants used include rice, pandan, coffee, banana, cassava, turmeric, ginger, coriander, cayenne pepper, red chili, pepper, candlenut, galangal, lemongrass, bay leaves, betel leaves, cloves, eggplant, cucumber, tomato, onion, garlic, areca nut, and jasmine. title: Video tutorial hasil analisis proksimat produk fermentasi mandai kulit cempedak (Artocarpus champeden Spreng.) dari Kalimantan Tengah
text_snippet: Video tutorial hasil analisis proksimat produk fermentasi mandai kulit cempedak (Artocarpus champeden Spreng.) dari Kalimantan Tengah Video tutorial merupakan salah satu media pembelajaran yang berpotensi mendukung pembelajaran sub materi bioteknologi konvensional. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis kelayakan media video tutorial sub materi bioteknologi konvensional dari hasil analisis proksimat produk fermentasi mandai kulit cempedak (Artocarpus champeden Spreng.). Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah deskriptif kuantitatif. Populasi penelitian meliputi dosen Pendidikan Biologi dan guru Biologi SMA/MA, dengan sampel terdiri atas 2 validator instrumen dan 5 validator media yang dipilih secara purposive sampling. Instrumen penelitian berupa lembar angket validasi media, sedangkan teknik pengumpulan data melalui penilaian validator. Analisis data menggunakan Content Validity Ratio (CVR) dan Content Validity Index (CVI). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa media video tutorial memenuhi 10 aspek, yaitu format, isi, bahasa, kesederhanaan, keterpaduan, penekanan, keseimbangan, bentuk, warna, dan efektivitas yang mencakup 28 kriteria penilaian, dengan nilai CVR dan CVI masing-masing sebesar 0,99. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan bahwa media video tutorial dinyatakan valid dan layak dalam segi isi, tampilan, dan fun

title: PENGEMBANGAN INSTRUMEN SOAL HOTS (HIGHER ORDER THINKING SKILLS) BERBASIS LITERASI SAINS PADA MATERI VIRUS UNTUK SISWA SMA
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN INSTRUMEN SOAL HOTS (HIGHER ORDER THINKING SKILLS) BERBASIS LITERASI SAINS PADA MATERI VIRUS UNTUK SISWA SMA Indonesian students' scientific literacy and Higher Order Thinking Skills (HOTS) skills remain low, reflecting the low cognitive level of learning and questions used at SMA Negeri 3 Langsa. This study aims to determine the feasibility and practicality of scientific literacy-based Higher Order Thinking Skills (HOTS) questions at the high school level. This study employed a Research and Development (R&D) method with a modified ADDIE development model, extending only to the development stage. The development stages included needs analysis, product design, expert validation, and practicality testing. The data analysis technique employed quantitative descriptive analysis, calculating the feasibility and practicality levels using percentage formulas and then interpreting them based on established assessment criteria. Validation was conducted by two validators: a material expert and a construct expert, with results of 91% and 84%, respectively, indicating highly valid questions. The practicality test yielded 100% from two biology teachers and 95.59% from 35 students, indicating highly practical questions. title: INVENTARISASI TUMBUHAN PARASIT DI KAWASAN HUTAN DESA OEBATU KECAMATAN ROTE BARAT DAYA KABUPATEN ROTE NDAO
text_snippet: INVENTARISASI TUMBUHAN PARASIT DI KAWASAN HUTAN DESA OEBATU KECAMATAN ROTE BARAT DAYA KABUPATEN ROTE NDAO Inventarisasi tumbuhan parasit sangat besar manfaatnya dalam rangka menambah wawasan mengenai keanekaragaman tumbuhan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk 1). menginventarisasi jenis-jenis tumbuhan parasit, 2). karakteristik mengetahui inang Di Kawasan Hutan Desa Oebatu, Kecamatan Rote Barat Daya, Kabupaten Rote Ndao. Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah metode deskriptif kualitatif dengan teknik pengambilan data eksplorasi dan sampling (plot). Hasil Penelitian telah ditemukan 3 spesies tumbuhan parasit yang diklasifikasikan ke dalam 3 famili yaitu Spesies Tali Putri ( Cassytha filiformis ), F.( Lauraceae ), Spesies Benalu ( Dendrophthoe pentandra ), F.( Loranthaceae ), dan spesies Cendana ( Santalum album ), F.( Santalaceae ). Berdasarkan ciri pada inangnya ditemukan 9 spesies inang yang diklasifikasikan dalam 2 ciri inang yaitu : pertama, pohon antara lain : Melaleuca leucadendra, Ziziphus mauritiana, Cassia fistula dan Mallotus philippensis . Yang kedua adalah produk yaitu: Tabernaemontana divaricata, Jatropha gossypiifolia, Chromolaena odorata, Annona squamosa dan Vitex trifolia .

title: PENGARUH E-MODUL BERBASIS PROBLEM BASED LEARNING TERHADAP KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KRITIS SISWA PADA MATERI EKOSISTEM KELAS X SMA NEGERI 2 PERBAUNGAN
text_snippet: PENGARUH E-MODUL BERBASIS PROBLEM BASED LEARNING TERHADAP KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KRITIS SISWA PADA MATERI EKOSISTEM KELAS X SMA NEGERI 2 PERBAUNGAN This study aimed to determine the effect of using a Problem Based Learning (PBL)-based e-module on students’ critical thinking skills in ecosystem material at Grade X of SMA Negeri 2 Perbaungan. An experimental method with a pretest-posttest control group design was employed. The sample consisted of two randomly selected classes: an experimental group that used the PBL-based e-module and a control group that received conventional direct instruction. Data were analyzed using normality and homogeneity tests, followed by a Z-test. The results showed a Z-count of 3.22, which exceeded the Z-table value of 1.96 at the 5% significance level, indicating a significant difference between the two groups. Therefore, the PBL-based e-module had a significant effect on students’ critical thinking skills and can be considered an alternative instructional resource for Biology learning, particularly on ecosystem topics.

title: EFEKTIVITAS SELF ASSESSMENT & PEER ASSESSMENT DALAM PEMBELAJARAN BIOLOGI SMA
text_snippet: EFEKTIVITAS SELF ASSESSMENT & PEER ASSESSMENT DALAM PEMBELAJARAN BIOLOGI SMA This study aimed to analyze the effectiveness of self-assessment and peer assessment in Biology learning at Muhammadiyah Waingapu Senior High School. A mixed-method approach with a descriptive design was employed, using observations, interviews, documentation, and questionnaires for data collection. The findings revealed that reflective assessment had not been implemented by teachers, and the assessment process remained predominantly teacher-centered. Nevertheless, students demonstrated a high level of readiness to implement both self-assessment (mean score 3.79) and peer assessment (mean score 3.49), with both instruments achieving very good results. These findings indicate that self-assessment and peer assessment have strong potential to support Biology learning and can serve as effective alternatives to complement teacher-centered assessment practices.

title: KEPRAKTISAN BUKU ENSIKLOPEDIA GENUS DENDROBIUM TAHURA SULTAN ADAM DALAM MELATIH KETERAMPILAN BERPIKIR KRITIS
text_snippet: KEPRAKTISAN BUKU ENSIKLOPEDIA GENUS DENDROBIUM TAHURA SULTAN ADAM DALAM MELATIH KETERAMPILAN BERPIKIR KRITIS 21st-century education emphasizes the development of 4C skills, one of which is critical thinking. Critical thinking skills can be fostered through various methods, including the use of instructional materials. In this study, the instructional material developed was an encyclopedia book. The purpose of this study was to examine the practicality of the Dendrobium genus encyclopedia book in the Sultan Adam Forest Park (Tahura Sultan Adam). This research employed an Educational Design Research (EDR) approach using Tessmer’s formative evaluation model, which includes self-evaluation, expert review, one-to-one evaluation, small group evaluation, and field testing. The expert review involved three experts, the one-to-one evaluation involved three students, the small group evaluation involved four students, and the field test involved ten students. The results showed that the encyclopedia book developed received a good category for content and These findings indicate that the developed Dendrobium genus encyclopedia is practical and easy to use in fostering students’ critical thinking skills.

The antibacterial effectiveness test was carried out using the disc diffusion method, followed by the development of the BIP designed to support microbiology learning in higher education, particularly for Biology Education students at UIN Antasari Banjarmasin. The antibacterial test data were analyzed using Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and the Least Significant Difference (LSD) test at a 5% significance level. title: PENGEMBANGAN HANDOUT ELEKTRONIK BERBASIS KONSEP PBL TENTANG FITOREMEDIASI MENGGUNAKAN BIJI Moringa oleifera PADA LIMBAH SASIRANGAN
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN HANDOUT ELEKTRONIK BERBASIS KONSEP PBL TENTANG FITOREMEDIASI MENGGUNAKAN BIJI Moringa oleifera PADA LIMBAH SASIRANGAN Sasirangan fabric, a cultural heritage of South Kalimantan, is produced by home industries in Kampung Sasirangan, Banjarmasin. The production process of sasirangan fabric generates textile waste that pollutes water, so an effective, inexpensive, and efficient waste treatment alternative is needed. Waste treatment is carried out using phytoremediation with Moringa oleifera seed powder as a biocoagulant. Moringa seeds have proven effective in precipitating textile waste pollutants from Sasirangan fabric, marking a new breakthrough in environmental treatment and can be utilized as educational material in biology. This study aims to develop an electronic Handout to support the Biotechnology course using the R&D method with a 4-D model based on problem-based learning. Data collection techniques use suitability and feasibility tests by 2 validators, readability tests by 6 students, and response tests by 9 Biology Education students at Lambung Mangkurat University.Â

title: PENGEMBANGAN HANDOUT ELEKTRONIK FUNGI BERBASIS RAGAM KOLONI JAMUR MIKROSKOPIS PADA PROSES FERMENTASI MANDAI
text_snippet: PENGEMBANGAN HANDOUT ELEKTRONIK FUNGI BERBASIS RAGAM KOLONI JAMUR MIKROSKOPIS PADA PROSES FERMENTASI MANDAI Mandai making is a form of local wisdom from the South Kalimantan region. During the fermentation process, various microscopic fungal colonies appear, which can be used as material for developing environmentally based biology teaching materials. This study developed an electronic Handout aimed at describing the results of suitability, feasibility, readability, and student responses. The Handout contains information on the fungal colonies found in the mandai fermentation process. The research used the R&D method with the 4-D model. The Define stage included analyzing the needs of students and teachers, tasks, concepts, learning objectives, and observations of fungal colonies. The Design stage involved instrument development, media and format selection, and initial Handout design. The Develop stage included validation by experts and revisions. The Disseminate stage focused on distributing the developed Handout. Data were collected using instruments for suitability, feasibility, readability, and student response. title: PENGARUH MODEL PJBL TERHADAP HASIL BELAJAR SISWA PADA MATERI SISTEM PENCERNAAN MANUSIA KELAS XI MAN GUNUNGSITOLI
text_snippet: PENGARUH MODEL PJBL TERHADAP HASIL BELAJAR SISWA PADA MATERI SISTEM PENCERNAAN MANUSIA KELAS XI MAN GUNUNGSITOLI This study aimed to determine the effect of the Project Based Learning (PjBL) model on students’ learning outcomes in the human digestive system material among Grade XI students of MAN Gunungsitoli in the 2025/2026 academic year. This research employed a quasi-experimental method using a pretest-posttest only control group design. The research sample consisted of class XI IPA 2 as the experimental class, which was taught using the Project Based Learning model, and class XI IPA 1 as the control class, which received conventional instruction. Data on students’ learning outcomes were collected using a validated test instrument consisting of 30 questions. The data were analyzed using an independent samples t-test to determine whether there was a significant difference in learning outcomes between the two groups. The results showed a significance value (Sig. 2-tailed) of 0.000, which was lower than the significance level of 0.05. title: PREVALENSI PENYAKIT MULUT DAN KUKU (PMK) PADA SAPI DI KOTA BATU JAWA TIMUR
text_snippet: PREVALENSI PENYAKIT MULUT DAN KUKU (PMK) PADA SAPI DI KOTA BATU JAWA TIMUR Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) is a highly contagious transboundary animal disease that significantly impacts the livestock sector. Batu City, one of the main cattle farming centers in East Java, has been affected by the FMD outbreak since 2022, yet local data on its prevalence and associated risk factors remain limited. This study aims to determine the prevalence of FMD in cattle in Batu City, identify key transmission risk factors, and evaluate the roles of both the government and farmers in controlling the outbreak. A descriptive quantitative method was employed using a cross-sectional approach, field interviews, and literature review. The data showed a total cattle population of 15,413, with 139 sick, 106 dead, 3,805 recovered, and 20 culled. The prevalence of FMD based on affected populations was 3.21%, and 0.90% based on the total cattle population. Major risk factors included communal housing systems, high animal mobility, inadequate biosecurity practices, uneven vaccination coverage, and low farmer awareness. This research employed a quantitative approach using a quasi-experimental method with a 3-factor pretest-posttest design, involving three levels: Discovery Learning, Interactive Demonstration, and Inquiry Lesson. A total of 108 students were selected through purposive sampling. The instrument used was an essay test on problem-solving skills, and the data were analyzed using normality and homogeneity tests, one-way ANOVA, and Post Hoc Scheffe tests. The results showed improvement across all groups, with the highest N-Gain in the Inquiry Lesson group (0.83), followed by Interactive Demonstration (0.76), and Discovery Learning (0.67). title: Konservasi Yang Hidup Dalam Ritual: Kajian Etnobiologi Upacara Kede Pada Masyarakat Adat Detupera
text_snippet: Konservasi Yang Hidup Dalam Ritual: Kajian Etnobiologi Upacara Kede Pada Masyarakat Adat Detupera This article discusses the “Kede” traditional ceremony as a form of local wisdom-based conservation that is still preserved by the Detupera indigenous community, Ende Regency. Through an ethnobiological approach, this research examines the symbolism, ritual structure, and ecological values contained in the traditional practice. The “Kede” ceremony reflects the spiritual relationship between humans, ancestors and nature, and contains customary rules that support the sustainable preservation of natural resources. The results show that the use of local plants such as leke, denu, kela and lelu has symbolic meanings that strengthen environmental conservation and biodiversity preservation. This ritual also functions as an intergenerational ecological education system within the indigenous community. Therefore, the “Kede” ceremony can be a contextual conservation model that integrates cultural values, spirituality, and ecological ethics in maintaining the balance of nature.Kata Kunci: Konservasi, Upacara Adat, Etnobiologi, Kearifan Lokal, Ritual

The e-booklet was declared valid and feasible to be tested, with validation from material experts of 97% and validation from teaching material experts of 92.5%. The e-booklet was also considered practical and useful for users, with a practicality percentage of 98% from biology subject teachers, 96% from small groups, and 98% from large groups. title: Upaya Meningkatkan Kolaborasi Peserta Didik SMAN 2 Kediri Melalui Model Pembelajaran ASICC
text_snippet: Upaya Meningkatkan Kolaborasi Peserta Didik SMAN 2 Kediri Melalui Model Pembelajaran ASICC Collaboration is a crucial learning skill that enables students to solve problems collectively and gain practical experience relevant to everyday life. Based on observations, researchers found that many students prefer to work independently and have an average of 58% in the low category. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct classroom action research (CAR) based on lesson study. This study aims to improve students' collaboration skills through the implementation of the ASICC learning model based on lesson study. This type of research is classroom action research conducted in two cycles. Data on students' collaboration skills were summarized as percentages in each cycle and meeting, and then compared to assess the increase in collaboration from the pre-cycle to cycle 1 and cycle 2. The study's results revealed an increase from 74.8% in cycle 1 to 85.1% in cycle 2. Thus, the implementation of the ASICC learning model is effective in improving student collaboration scores at SMAN 2 Kediri. Kata kunci: pembelajaran, ASICC, kolaborasi

The purpose of this study is to determine and analyze the LKPD on Omosis practicum based on instruments from Novak and Gowin based on Vee Diagram. The results of the analysis showed that the initial LKPD scored 40.74% and was classified as very poor, especially in the aspects of focus questions, objects, theories and concepts, tools and materials, activity steps, and knowledge statements. Based on these results, LKPD reconstruction was carried out to improve existing deficiencies to make it more relevant to the learning objectives of practicum-based biology. The reconstruction includes rearranging the focus question, adding the theory and principles of osmosis, and adjusting the lab work steps to support contextual learning and strengthening students' science process skills. The purpose of this study is to describe the types of moss on the banks of the Mawangi Village river and describe the approriateness, feasibility, readability, and effectiveness of the developed e-booklet. The e-booklet was developed adopting the 4D model technique (Define, Design, Develop, and Disseminate), however, is was only developed to the limited distribution stage in this study. Two Biology Education FKIP ULM lecturers and a Biology teacher from SMAN 1 Kandangan participated in the suitability and feasibility tests. Nine students participated in the readability test, while seventeen students participated in the effectiveness test. According to the study’s results, 8 types of Bryophyta were found on the banks of the Mawangi Village River, Hulu Sungai Selatan Regency, including Ectropothecium sp., Fissidens sp., Calymperes sp., Octoblepharum sp., Thuidium sp., Bryum sp., Riccia sp., and Anthoceros sp.
